subject: Closing cadence + GPU pool sizing constraints for Crestline MAP
messages:
From: Tom Evans <tom.evans@crestline.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Closing cadence + GPU pool sizing constraints (Crestline)

Logan / Neha / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency and inference throughput looked good. Were trying to firm up an internal timeline so we can commit to a Dedicated pool in Q3. A few constraints and asks from our side: 

- Lead times: our procurement requires an implementation window no later than mid-September. Can you confirm typical H100 lead times for Dedicated pools and whether you support mixed tranches?
- Sizing: initial forecast attached (crestline_capacity_requirements.xlsx) shows 200 concurrent LLM sessions, peak 120k tokens/minute. Wed like a proposed pool sizing and a staging tranche option for an 8-week canary.
- Acceptance: whats your standard acceptance criteria for private/Dedicated handoff (latency p95, perf regression threshold, SOC2 evidence needed)?

From a MAP perspective, wed like a mutual action plan that ties evaluation milestones to procurement milestones — two-week perf validation, on-prem security review (SOC2 gap items), and a final commitment date. Can you send a MAP with explicit timelines we can attach to our procurement packet?

Appreciate a concise milestone table and any constraints on scheduling (GPU delivery windows, blackout dates).

Tom
Tom Evans
Head of Infrastructure, Crestline AI
ops@crestline.ai

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Tom Evans <tom.evans@crestline.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Closing cadence + GPU pool sizing constraints (Crestline)

Tom — thanks for the clear ask and the worksheet, that helps. High level answers inline, then a short MAP sketch.

- Lead times: H100 Dedicated lead time to full production-ready pool (including provisioning, model onboarding, acceptance) is typically 10–14 weeks from signed commitment; we can sometimes compress to 8 weeks with a partial/tranche delivery (staged allocation), depending on region and quota. Mixed tranches (H100 + A100) are supported; we recommend pinning critical inference to H100 and using A100 for less latency-sensitive workloads.
- Sizing: based on your numbers Ive sketched a conservative starting pool: 8 H100 GPUs + 12 A100 GPUs with autoscaling headroom (estimated sustained tokens/min target). Well provide a detailed cost/throughput table in the MAP.
- Acceptance: typical acceptance gating: (1) perf validation (p95 < target), (2) integration test pass (prefix cache behavior), (3) security checklist (SOC2 evidence, audit logs enabled), (4) production traffic canary for 2–4 weeks. We can capture exact metrics in the MAP so procurement has objective criteria.

Proposed MAP (high level) — we can convert this into a PDF for procurement:
1) Week 0 (post-sign): Legal & billing signoff + kick-off call
2) Week 1–2: Eval sandbox provisioning + perf baseline (initial model tests)
3) Week 3–4: Performance tuning & KV/prefix cache validation
4) Week 5–6: Security evidence handoff (SOC2 artifacts, logs) + Ops runbook review
5) Week 7–8: Staged canary (20% traffic) + acceptance metrics collection
6) Week 9–10: Full pool activation + final acceptance and handover

Ill attach a formatted MAP (proposed_MAP_v2.pdf) and a compact pool sizing/throughput estimate. Questions for you: are there blackout weeks in August/September for your infra team? Also confirm whether procurement requires a hard delivery SLA that we should surface in the deal terms.

Attaching: proposed_MAP_v2.pdf (sketch), and Ill follow up with the throughput table separately.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
log an.wright@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

[attachment: proposed_MAP_v2.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

Subject: Re: Closing cadence + GPU pool sizing constraints (Crestline)

Logan — helpful, thanks. A couple quick clarifications: 

- Blackout: our infra team is mostly out the week of Aug 9–13, so pushing heavy provisioning earlier is preferred.
- SLA: procurement will ask for a committed activation date; theyre used to seeing a lead time buffer (we can accept a 2-week start window).
- Tranche: wed like the staged canary to be available by Aug 23 if possible. If that maps to Week 7–8 in your MAP, well need signed commitment by June 11.

Assume Crestline is ok with a mixed pool as long as the critical models run on H100. Please include the cost delta for an accelerated 8-week path vs the standard 10–14 week path in your follow-up.

Tom

Tom — looping back with a concise mutual action plan and the acceptance checklist so procurement has an itemizable artifact. Ive also added the accelerated path costs and explicit milestone dates (see below).

Mutual Action Plan (finalized) — Crestline AI / Redwood Inference
Deal: DL-2027-8127 | Region: US

Key milestones and target dates (accelerated path):
- Signed commitment: 2027-06-11 (legal/billing)
- Eval sandbox provisioned: 2027-06-14 to 2027-06-28 (2 weeks)
- Perf tuning & integration: 2027-06-29 to 2027-07-12 (2 weeks)
- Security evidence handoff: 2027-07-13 to 2027-07-19 (1 week)
- Staged canary activation (20% traffic): 2027-08-23 to 2027-09-06 (2 weeks)
- Full pool activation & final acceptance: Target 2027-09-13 (final handover)

Pool sizing (recommended, initial):
- 8x H100 (primary inference), 12x A100 (background/replicas)
- Autoscaling policy: scale by token throughput thresholds; burst capacity reserve = 30%
- Canary configuration: prefix caching enabled; KV cache warm-up plan during first 24h

Acceptance criteria (measurable):
- Latency: p95 <= 220ms at target concurrency during canary
- Quality regression: model output BLEU/ROUGE deviation within agreed thresholds (we will predefine prompt set)
- Reliability: error rate < 0.5% sustained
- Security: SOC2 artifacts delivered + audit logs enabled for 90 days retention

Accelerated path delta (relative to standard 12-week):
- Acceleration fee: one-time setup surcharge equivalent to 6% of first 12 months committed spend (covers expedited provisioning & priority scheduling)
- Tradeoffs: less time for multi-model tuning; we recommend an initial controlled canary for models with highest RTO risk

Next steps / asks from Crestline:
1) Confirm signed commitment date (weve penciled 2027-06-11).
2) Confirm blackout week (you noted Aug 9-13). Well avoid heavy ops during that window.
3) Sign the attached mutual_action_plan_final.docx and upload to your procurement portal / share the HubSpot record link so we can attach the MAP.

Ill kick off a 30-minute MAP review call with your team once we have a commitment date — propose Tue 2027-06-15 10:00 PT.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
